answer: Rotation is entered in the pulse index and the crystal audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the spiral beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 74 keys live and online for the whole period, as a result the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 28 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
